author: Ari Koslow
title: Teoscar Hernandez (hamstring) to be activated Monday
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Teoscar Hernandez will be activated from the injured list on Monday.
impact: Hernandez has gone yard in three straight rehab games. He will return for Monday's series opener against the Athletics.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Loftin leaves game early Saturday
desc: Nick Loftin left Saturday's game in the ninth inning after being hit by a thrown ball.
impact: Loftin was hit in the field on a throw by Daniel Lynch IV. He was able to slowly walk off the field.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Heliot Ramos (quad) to be activated Sunday
desc: Heliot Ramos will be activated from the injured list on Sunday.
impact: Ramos concluded his rehab assignment on Friday. There should be an official roster move before first pitch on Sunday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Wilson (shoulder) remains out of lineup Saturday
desc: Jacob Wilson is not in the Athletics lineup again on Saturday against the Angels.
impact: Wilson will miss his third straight game after being removed early from Wednesday's game. He remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Siri activated from paternity list
desc: The Angels activated OF Jose Siri from the paternity list.
impact: Siri makes his return after being away for a few days. Christian Moore was optioned as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Christian Moore optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Angels optioned INF Christian Moore to Triple-A Salt Lake.
impact: Moore went 4-for-20 with 11 strikeouts in nine days with the Angels. He should get another opportunity in the majors later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kai-Wei Teng expected to be optioned by Astros
desc: The Astros are expected to option Kai-Wei Teng to Triple-A Sugar Land.
impact: Teng allowed five runs (four earned) over 3 2/3 innings on Saturday against the Tigers. He has minor-league options remaining, and should get another opportunity later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Miguel Ullola to be called up by Astros
desc: The Astros are calling up pitching prospect Miguel Ullola.
impact: Ullola made the move to become a reliever. He'll add a fresh arm in the Astros bullpen for Sunday's series finale against the Tigers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Vasquez to pitch in bulk relief role Saturday
desc: Randy Vasquez will pitch in a bulk relief role on Saturday against the Dodgers.
impact: Kyle Hart will open the game for the Padres. Vasquez will pitch behind him in a bulk role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Hart to open game Saturday
desc: Kyle Hart will open Saturday's game for the Padres against the Dodgers.
impact: Hart will figure to take the mound for the first inning. Randy Vásquez will follow him in a bulk relief role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Ferguson recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Cubs recalled Tyler Ferguson from Triple-A Iowa.
impact: Ferguson will return to the majors in a middle-relief role with Hoby Milner placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hoby Milner (appendicitis) placed on IL
desc: The Cubs placed Hoby Milner on the 15-day IL with appendicitis.
impact: Milner becomes the latest Cubs pitcher to land on the injured list. Tyler Ferguson was recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryse Wilson activated by Cubs
impact: Wilson will report to the Cubs on Saturday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Altuve makes early exit Saturday
desc: Jose Altuve left Saturday's game against the Tigers with a possible injury.
impact: There will be an update on Altuve when available.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Carrasco re-signs with Braves on minor league deal
desc: The Braves re-signed RHP Carlos Carrasco to a minor league contract.
impact: Carrasco returns to the Braves organization after electing free agency.
